note: Approved commentator and radio DJ lines, one take each. Audio is Opus; .mouth.json is per-frame ARKit mouth weights, .face.json the rest of the face. Scripts and directions are in audio/dialogue/.

close-battle.label: Barnaby: close battle
close-battle.text: Puddles and Marmalade, side by side, nothing in it.

crash-major.label: Barnaby: crash (Major)
crash-major.text: And the Major has gone into the duck pond.

daytime-grumble.label: Barnaby: daytime grumble
daytime-grumble.text: A lovely sunny afternoon for it. I do so hate them.

finish-asleep-at-the-line.label: Barnaby: finish (asleep at the line)
finish-asleep-at-the-line.text: Asleep at the line, apparently. That takes some doing.

impartial.label: Barnaby: impartial
impartial.text: We're meant to be impartial, Penny.

item-hit-hettie.label: Barnaby: item hit (Hettie)
item-hit-hettie.text: That'll be Hettie's. She'll be apologising for a full lap.

lap-record.label: Barnaby: lap record
lap-record.text: That is a new lap record for the quarry run. I shall have to use ink.

last-lap-cowbell.label: Barnaby: last lap cowbell
last-lap-cowbell.text: Last lap. The bell, such as it is, is a cowbell.

overtake-mabel.label: Barnaby: overtake (Mabel)
overtake-mabel.text: Mabel through on the inside at the mill. Unhurried, as ever.

race-start.label: Barnaby: race start
race-start.text: Lights are on. And they're away.

racing-report-1-opening.label: Racing Report 1 (Barnaby): opening
racing-report-1-opening.text: This is the Racing Report, from the Braynard Blimp. I'm Barnaby Hoot.

racing-report-3-results.label: Racing Report 3 (Barnaby): results
racing-report-3-results.text: We are. Today's Home Farm Cup went to Maximillian Gallop, for the third week running.

racing-report-5-coming-up.label: Racing Report 5 (Barnaby): coming up
racing-report-5-coming-up.text: Next up is the Sawmill Run, at six this evening. We'll be drifting over the woods to have a look.

racing-report-7-records.label: Racing Report 7 (Barnaby): records
racing-report-7-records.text: Records. Someone flew sixty metres off the quarry this morning. Not recommended.

racing-report-9-sign-off.label: Racing Report 9 (Barnaby): sign-off
racing-report-9-sign-off.text: That's the Racing Report. Back to the music.

cow-through-a-hedge.label: Penny: cow through a hedge
cow-through-a-hedge.text: Like a cow through a hedge, that! Lovely!

duvet-wins.label: Penny: Duvet wins
duvet-wins.text: Duvet wins it! Is Duvet even awake?

egg-in-the-goggles.label: Penny: egg in the goggles
egg-in-the-goggles.text: Ooh! Egg, right in the goggles!

feather-duster.label: Penny: feather duster
feather-duster.text: Cheer up, you old feather duster!

off-his-perch.label: Penny: off his perch
off-his-perch.text: Somebody knock him off his perch, I'm begging you.

race-start.label: Penny: race start
race-start.text: Go on! Go on, the lot of you!

racing-report-2-hello.label: Racing Report 2 (Penny): hello
racing-report-2-hello.text: And I'm Penny Speckle! We're over the cornfields this afternoon, aren't we, Barnaby?

racing-report-4-down-a-peg.label: Racing Report 4 (Penny): down a peg
racing-report-4-down-a-peg.text: Third! Somebody needs to take that horse down a peg. Hettie came second, and laid two eggs on the podium.

racing-report-6-rumour.label: Racing Report 6 (Penny): rumour
racing-report-6-rumour.text: And a little rumour for you. I swear I saw something shiny under the Mill River bridge. Just saying.

bpm-countdown.label: Strut: BPM countdown
bpm-countdown.text: We are cruising at one twenty-eight beats per minute. Let's take it to one thirty! One thirty-two! One thirty-five! Whoa, too far. Back to one twenty-eight. Here's Barn Door Breakdown!

cowbell-overload-intro.label: Strut: Cowbell Overload intro
cowbell-overload-intro.text: Mabel, this one's for you! It's Cowbell Overload, and the cowbell count today is: infinite!

pit-stop-advert-outro.label: Strut: Pit Stop advert outro
pit-stop-advert-outro.text: This hour of Barn Party Music comes to you from the Pit Stop! Tyres, toasties and tow ropes. Strut approved! Keep it loud!

racing-report-intro.label: Strut: Racing Report intro
racing-report-intro.text: Shades down, feathers up! It's time for the Racing Report, with Barnaby and Penny, live from the blimp! Hit it!

station-intro.label: Strut: station intro
station-intro.text: Yeah! BPM one oh four point one, Barn Party Music! It's DJ Strut, and that last track, Hay Bale Hyperdrive? Best song ever made. Until this one!

tractor-joke.label: Strut: tractor joke
tractor-joke.text: Why did the tractor go to the party? It heard there'd be loads of torque! I'm here all week, Braynard!

traffic.label: Strut: traffic
traffic.text: Traffic and travel, Strut style! Landslide on the Pass road, so go round it. Or go over it. I'm not your mum!

advice.label: Earl: advice
advice.text: Here's something I learned the hard way. If somebody cares about you, they'll wait for you at the finish line. And if they don't, well. That's what the next song's for. Here's Salt Marsh Sunset.

back-announce-hometown-champion.label: Earl: back-announce Hometown Champion
back-announce-hometown-champion.text: That was Hometown Champion, requested once again by a certain horse. Third time today, Max. We heard you, friend.

listener-letter-worried-hen.label: Earl: listener letter (Worried Hen)
listener-letter-worried-hen.text: Got a letter here. It says, Dear Earl, my friend keeps overtaking me on the last lap, and never waits for me. Signed, Worried Hen. Well, Worried Hen. Maybe stop waiting for folks, and start passing them. This one's for you. Second Place Heart.

racing-report-intro.label: Earl: Racing Report intro
racing-report-intro.text: Now let's hand on over to our friends up in the blimp. Barnaby, Penny, the county's all yours.

station-intro.label: Earl: station intro
station-intro.text: Well, hey there, friend. This is Easy Earl, on K-Corn ninety-eight point seven, Fresh Country. Ease off that throttle a little.

weather.label: Earl: weather
weather.text: Bit of rain coming in over the orchard tonight, so if you're driving, take it slow. Slow is how the good things happen.

county-news.label: Gus: county news
county-news.text: News from the county. There's a race on tonight, down at the sawmill. I'd go along myself, only I'd get there round about Thursday.

racing-report-intro.label: Gus: Racing Report intro
racing-report-intro.text: And now, for the young folks, here's the Racing Report. That's the owl, and the noisy one.

station-intro.label: Gus: station intro
station-intro.text: Well now. Good evening, or good morning, whichever it is out there. This is Old Gus, on Hay ten-fifty, The Old Hay Ride. And here's a brand new one. Ninety Years on the Hay Ride.

the-goat-anecdote-part-1.label: Gus: the goat anecdote, part 1
the-goat-anecdote-part-1.text: That was Lonesome Goose. Reminds me. Back in the summer of, oh, must've been fifty-one, a fella came up to the shack with a goat, and a fiddle, and a bucket of, well, you'd never guess what was in that bucket. Now, the goat. The goat was called

the-goat-anecdote-part-2.label: Gus: the goat anecdote, part 2
the-goat-anecdote-part-2.text: Now, where was I. The goat. Yes. The goat was called Henrietta, and the bucket, the bucket was full of, hold on, that's Sawmill Breakdown starting
